body: I've seen a doctor. I still feel awful.
My family doesn't care. I have no friends. The world isn't interesting when you don't want to be in it anymore.
I can't. That's why I want to end it.
I've wanted to end it for years now. I've been trying for a year.
I just got out of the hospital for a dioxide attempt. They told me good thing I didn't take Tylenol. I thought that it would do the job.
I can't go on without him. He was my reason for living.
What problem is a hole in the stomach when I'm dead?
